modules.name: Invaders from Afar
modules.note: Adds Albion and Togawa; enables 6-7 players.

steps.text: An encounter token on each encounter territory ({n} total)
Resources, coins and multiplier tokens in a supply by the board
Shuffle the combat, encounter and objective decks onto the board
Deal {n} random Factory cards facedown onto the board; box the rest unseen
Random structure bonus tile faceup at the bottom of the Popularity Track
Reveal 1 random aggressive (red) and 1 passive (green) airship tile next to the encounter deck
Draw 1 random resolution tile, read it aloud, place it by the Triumph Track
Mix Albion's and Togawa's faction and player mats into the others
Deal each player a random faction mat and player mat; sit by your home base
6-7 players: Crimea and Polania swap in their replacement ability tokens
Power token and popularity token on the levels shown on your mats
Draw the combat cards, objective cards and coins shown on your mats
Character on your home base; 1 worker on each of the 2 land territories next to it
Your airship on your home base
Player mat: 6 workers above Produce, 6 tech cubes on the marked boxes, 4 structures and 4 recruits on their spaces, action token beside it
Faction mat: 6 stars top left, 4 mechs on the mech abilities
Give the Automa a faction mat (a home base far from yours is easiest)
Automa gets the power and combat cards shown on its mat (facedown, unseen) and 5 coins
Automa's popularity token on 10; it never moves
Automa's character and 2 workers on the board; mechs, stars and other workers on its mat
Pick a star tracker card for the difficulty; tech cube on its "I" space
Shuffle the 19 Automa cards facedown, all facing the same way
Rusviet
details: Relentless: may pick the same Player Mat section (or Factory card) as last turn

steps.text: Crimea
details: Coercion: once per turn, spend 1 combat card as any 1 resource (worth nothing at game end)

steps.text: Nordic
details: Swim: workers (not character or mechs) may move across rivers, not onto lakes

steps.text: Polania
details: Meander: pick up to 2 options on each encounter card; the first may pay for the second

steps.text: Saxony
details: Dominate: no limit on stars from objectives and combat; may complete both objectives
Must place a star for each combat win while it has stars

steps.text: You may start your turn once the player on your right starts a bottom-row action
Airships never control territories
The resolution tile decides when and how the game ends
Lowest player mat number goes first; play is clockwise
Each turn: move your action token to a new section and take its top and/or bottom action
